data.name: Faeen
data.gender_notes: Faeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is elegant and delicate in her actions and words. The name Faeen carries the meaning “Elegant, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Faeen usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and beauty of Allah's creation.
data.etymology: Faeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegant, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faeen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فاين
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفين و معناه النجاة و الخلاص
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاين مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ألفين، والذي يعني النجاة والخلاص. ورد في اللغة العربية الفصحى، ويحمل دلالات إيجابية تتعلق بالفلاح والنجاح. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتعبر عن الأمل في النجاة والفوز بالخير

in_urdu.name: فیئن
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے نجاة اور خلاصی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیئن نام عربی زبان کی root الفین سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نجاة اور خلاصی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اچھے معنی رکھتا ہے اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلمانوں میں پایا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام امید اور کامیابی کی دلالت کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फाएन
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है मोक्ष और मुक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: फाएन नाम की उत्पत्ति عربی भाषा के मूल الفین से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मोक्ष और मुक्ति। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और यह आशा और सफलता की भावना को दर्शाता है। इस नाम का चयन आमतौर पर माता-पिता अपनी संतान के लिए सकारात्मक गुणों की कामना के साथ करते हैं

in_pashto.name: فاين

in_english.name: Faeen
in_english.meaning: Derived from Al-Fayn, signifying salvation and deliverance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faeen originates from the Arabic root الفين (Al-Fayn), which connotes the meanings of salvation, deliverance, and rescue. In Islamic tradition, this name carries positive connotations of hope, success, and liberation. Historically, names derived from such roots have been chosen for their spiritual significance and aspirational qualities. The name Faeen is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a parent's wish for their child's well-being and prosperity

data.cultural_impact: Faeen is a beautiful name with an Arabic origin. The name signifies refinement, elegance, and delicacy. In Islamic culture, the naming of a child holds great significance. It is believed that a name reflects the innate qualities and characteristics of a person. A name like Faeen, which implies an air of gracefulness and poise, is highly valued in many Middle Eastern and Islamic communities. It reflects an admirable and desirable trait for a girl to possess. The name Faeen may also inspire those who bear it to strive towards being elegant and refined in their speech, actions, and demeanor, thus adding to the overall beauty and charm of their personality.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Faeen carries a deeper and more profound meaning. It is believed that each name has a hidden meaning that is only revealed to the individual through their personal spiritual journey. For Faeen, the spiritual significance could be interpreted as a reminder to be mindful of one's words and actions. In Islam, it is emphasized that every deed, no matter how small, will be accounted for in the hereafter. As someone named Faeen, one may be encouraged to reflect on the spiritual implications of their actions and words, and to strive towards being a source of grace and elegance in all aspects of their life, for the pleasure of Allah (SWT) and for the betterment of the collective human community. The name Faeen may thus serve as a powerful reminder to be compassionate, kind, and gracious in all situations, and to remember that every action, no matter how small, can have a profound impact on the individual and those around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Elegant, Delicate" symbolizes One who is elegant and delicate in her actions and words.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Faeen serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of elegant, delicate.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ali ibn Abi Talib was the cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Faeen carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Faeen remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Aisha Faeen from Istanbul, Turkey embodies the meaning of Faeen - "Elegant, Delicate". Growing up, they were known for their strong character and deep faith, always striving to live up to the beautiful significance of their name.
